review_notes: Independently opened all five 998x701 real Tauri Windows screenshots. DWM frame excludes desktop/taskbar, native titlebar is expected, right scrollbar is dark, PageDown continuation visibly exposes previously below-fold content and footer. Settings/Recovery/Diagnostics navigate correctly and show disabled/read-only foundation states. Text is legible and no personal content, credentials or user paths are present. Previews are not proof that the future M16/M17/M18 options or backup/restore are implemented.
